notes: Structured effects of Hellboy (F07 steps 4-6) in DSL v1 (docs/effects-dsl.md). Text read from the real cards (sheet 197 of the tournament save) on 2026-10-28; where unmatched-memory differs the card wins and it is noted in docs/heroes/hellboy.md. Migrated to the canonical schema on 2026-10-28 without changing the semantics.
Forms are not a state: they are always recomputed from the destiny counter of the discard (overlay forms/counters). That is why no op 'sets' the form: it is only queried with the form_is condition.
Every damage is effect damage (Horseshoes, Posthumous Power): Planned Recklessness' shield stops it and it also reaches your own fighters.
Ivan's decision (28/10): Right Hand Of Doom: OCCULT DETECTIVE is evaluated before the card itself reaches the discard.
Ivan's decision (28/10): Pancakes!: the chosen options resolve in printed order.
Ivan's decision (28/10): form change with the bot: it changes miniature and token and pings both.
Ivan's decision (28/10): the human's choices (Confront, Posthumous Power, Pancakes!) by panel buttons that ONLY appear when the card is played; meanwhile they are not shown (not even greyed out).

ability.text: AHH CRAP! At the start of the game, place the Hellboy Special Ability Token over this card with the OCCULT DETECTIVE side up. OCCULT DETECTIVE: At the start of your turn, if Hellboy is in an opponent's starting space, you may draw 2 cards. When you have 6 or more destiny cards in your discard pile, switch to ANUNG UN RAMA. ANUNG UN RAMA: At the start of your turn, discard 1 card. Move Hellboy a number of spaces up to its BOOST value. Add +2 to Hellboy's attacks. When you have 5 or fewer destiny cards in your discard pile, switch to OCCULT DETECTIVE.
ability.notes: Forms: OCCULT DETECTIVE with 5 or fewer destinies in the discard, ANUNG UN RAMA with 6 or more (overlay forms + counters.destiny, 11 destinies of 30). The change is immediate as soon as the counter changes (when discarding a played card, when moving cards from the discard to the deck with Pancakes!, when shuffling the discard in when the deck runs out). The engine already recomputes it from data; on the table the token and the miniature represent it (see table). Today the triggers are run by Game.hellboy_detective_draw and Game.hellboy_anung_start and combat.py reads the passive as attack_bonus.

cards.title: Excalibur
cards.notes: Attack 6 / boost 3, Hellboy only, destiny. No text.

cards.title: Right Hand Of Doom
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Move an adjacent fighter up to 1 space. If Hellboy is OCCULT DETECTIVE, move Hellboy up to 1 space.
cards.notes: Attack 4 / boost 1, Hellboy only, destiny. 'Adjacent fighter' is any living fighter adjacent to Hellboy, own or rival (Lobster included); moving 0 is legal. The form is queried when resolving the AFTER, before the card itself (destiny) reaches the discard: see open_questions.

cards.title: Horseshoes And Hand Grenades
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Deal 1 damage to each other fighter in your fighter's zone.
cards.notes: Attack 2 / boost 1, anyone. Effect damage (not combat): the rival's Planned Recklessness shield stops it and it also reaches your own (Lobster in the same zone). If the fighter that played it died in the combat it has no zone and nothing happens (the engine already does it this way).

cards.title: Second Shot
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: You may BOOST this attack.
cards.notes: Attack 2 / boost 2, Lobster Johnson only. The card says 'You may BOOST this attack' (unmatched-memory: the same). If the rival's IMMEDIATELY cancels its effects there is no BOOST. The boost card is discarded face up: public information. Today combat.can_boost detects it by text; may_boost is the datum that replaces it.

cards.title: Confront Any Demon or God
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Draw 1 card. Then, if you lost the combat, look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 card for them to discard.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 1, Hellboy only, destiny. First draws, then (only if lost) the rival's hand is looked at and the card to discard is chosen. With the rival's hand empty nothing is discarded. It is the only Hellboy card that touches hidden information: see hidden_info.

cards.title: Glimpse Of Hell
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Draw 2 cards, then shuffle a card from your hand into your deck.
cards.notes: Versatile 2 / boost 3, anyone. Draws 2 and then shuffles ONE card from the hand (any, not necessarily one of those drawn) into the deck, face down. If the deck is empty when drawing the discard is shuffled first (general rule).

cards.title: B.P.R.D. Training
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Draw 1 card. Move each friendly fighter up to 2 spaces.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 2, anyone. Each living own fighter moves up to 2 (0 included), one after another, in the order the owner chooses. Physical movements: the human does them on the table; the bot moves its miniatures.

cards.title: Planned Recklessness
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Your fighters can't take damage from effects this turn. If Hellboy is OCCULT DETECTIVE, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 3, anyone (not destiny). 'This turn' is the current turn, whoever's it is: if played in defense the shield lasts until the end of the attacker's turn. The shield stops effect damage (Horseshoes, Posthumous Power, Medusa's gaze on her turn...) but not combat damage. The cancellation only in OCCULT DETECTIVE and it is decided when resolving the IMMEDIATELY (the card is not yet in the discard). The engine already does exactly this (combat.py, PLANNED; Game.effect_shield).

cards.title: Posthumous Power
cards.text:
AFTER COMBAT: Choose one:
- each friendly fighter recovers 1 health
- deal 1 damage to any fighter
- move any fighter up to 3 spaces

options.label: move any fighter up to 3 spaces

cards.notes: Versatile 2 / boost 3, Lobster Johnson only. 'Any fighter' includes own and rival ones. If Lobster died in that combat the AFTER resolves anyway (the card was played). When the human plays it, the bot needs to know the option: panel buttons or reading the table (dials and positions) as a fallback.

cards.title: On Earth As It Is In Hell
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: This card's value becomes the number of destiny cards in your discard pile. AFTER COMBAT: If you lost the combat, Hellboy recovers 2 health.
cards.notes: Defense 0 / boost 2, Hellboy only, destiny. The value becomes the number of destinies in the discard at that moment (the card itself does not count yet). If the rival's IMMEDIATELY cancels it, it stays at 0 and does not heal. The engine already does it this way (ON_EARTH in combat.py).

cards.title: And Upon His Brow Is Set A Crown Of Flame
cards.text: Discard your hand. Draw 2 cards. Gain 2 actions.
cards.notes: Scheme, boost 4, Hellboy only, destiny. Playing it costs 1 action and gives 2: net +1. The scheme has already left the hand when the rest is discarded. The discarded cards are public; the 2 drawn, not.

cards.title: Pancakes!
cards.text:
Chose two different effects:
- Hellboy recovers 2 health
- put up to 2 non-scheme cards in your discard pile on the bottom of your deck
- draw 2 cards

options.label: put up to 2 non-scheme cards in your discard pile on the bottom of your deck

cards.notes: Scheme, boost 2, Hellboy only (NOT destiny). The card says 'Choose two different effects' (printed: 'Chose'). Returning destinies from the discard to the bottom of the deck lowers the counter and can return Hellboy to OCCULT DETECTIVE: it is a form lever, not just recycling. The chosen cards are seen when moved (public) and stay at the bottom of the deck in an order known to both. Resolution order of the two options: see open_questions.

hero_miniatures.how: They are two states of the same object: f9789a has States {2: e6f06e}. setState(2) on f9789a produces e6f06e at the same position and setState(1) on e6f06e returns to f9789a. That is why config/table.json pieces.hellboy lists both GUIDs.

dials.destiny: e17c66 'Destiny Dial' (the bot already sets it to the destinies in the discard)

deck.custom_deck: 197 on the deck, 187 on the loose cards (same FaceURL/BackURL, 8x4)

choreography: Form change when the bot plays Hellboy: it is not a rule but table choreography (formerly the plugin hellboy:form_change_on_table). When the destiny counter crosses the threshold, the bot changes the state of the miniature, turns the ability token and pings both (Ivan's rule). When Hellboy is the human's, the bot only announces the change.
1. Announce in the chat the new form and the destiny count (already done).
2. Miniature: getObjectFromGUID(current).setState(2 if ANUNG UN RAMA, 1 if OCCULT DETECTIVE); the resulting GUID is the other of the pair f9789a/e6f06e (the session already accepts either).
3. Token: getObjectFromGUID('1644a3').flip() only if the visible face is not already the new form's (check rotZ first: 180 = blue/OCCULT DETECTIVE, 0 = red/ANUNG UN RAMA).

4. Ping the token's position and, ~1 s later, the miniature (two pings in a row step on each other: lua._ping_lua already waits 1 s). All inside pcall: a table failure does not change the engine's state.
5. Destiny Dial e17c66 to the new count (already done).

hidden_info.what: look_hand on the rival's hand after losing the combat, and a discard chosen among what was seen.
hidden_info.bot_plays_it: The bot reads the human's hand ONLY when resolving this AFTER (never earlier, never in another card), chooses the card to discard and keeps the rest as the human's KnownHand. From then on it discounts each seen card when the human plays it, discards it, returns it to the deck or loses it; those the human draws afterwards are unknown. It never takes as playable a seen card that already left.
hidden_info.human_plays_it: The human has the right to see the bot's hand: the bot reveals it (announcement in the chat or face-up cards) and the human chooses with panel buttons which card the bot discards.

hidden_info.what: Returns a card from the hand to the deck face down and shuffled.
hidden_info.bot_sees: If the human plays it, the bot does not know which one went: in the human's KnownHand no seen card remains certain; they degrade to 'possible' (they stay in the model with the hand count, but not as certainty). The 2 drawn are unknown.
hidden_info.bot_plays_it: The bot physically shuffles a card face down into its deck; the human does not see it.

hidden_info.card: And Upon His Brow Is Set A Crown Of Flame
hidden_info.what: Discards the whole hand (public) and draws 2 (hidden).
hidden_info.bot_sees: If the human plays it, the human's KnownHand is emptied (everything discarded is seen in the discard) and becomes 2 unknown cards.

hidden_info.what: Draws 2 (hidden); the cards from the discard that go to the bottom of the deck are seen when moved.
hidden_info.bot_sees: The returned ones are public and both know they are at the bottom: the bot can remember they will not come out until the deck is exhausted (the human knows it too, it is not cheating). The 2 drawn are unknown.

hidden_info.what: Discards 1 card at the start of the turn: public.
hidden_info.bot_sees: If the human discards it, it is discounted from their KnownHand if it was a seen one.

hidden_info.card: OCCULT DETECTIVE (ability) and the draws of Confront, Glimpse, B.P.R.D. Training
hidden_info.what: Draws: unknown cards for the rival.
hidden_info.bot_sees: It only changes the count of the rival's hand; nothing is inferred from the content.

hidden_info.what: The boost card is discarded face up.
hidden_info.bot_sees: Publica: se descuenta de la KnownHand si era vista.
